statement.zh: 将阿royo 佩斯克罗绿石组合当作严格发掘出土的地层闭合组合，证据不足（多为非控制发现）。
statement.en: Treating the Arroyo Pesquero greenstone corpus as a stratigraphically closed excavated assemblage overreaches (mostly uncontrolled finds).

disclaimer: Hypothesis / provenience caution — not established fact. Labelled kind=hypothesis.
